title: Geometry - Lesson 7 Assessment: Missing Sides in 45-45-90 Triangles
description: Demonstrate mastery of deriving and applying 45-45-90 triangle side relationships to find missing sides.

questions.question: A square has side length 5 cm. What is the length of its diagonal?
questions.explanation: A square diagonal forms the hypotenuse of a 45-45-90 triangle with legs 5 and 5, so the diagonal is 5sqrt(2) cm.

questions.question: A 45-45-90 triangle has a hypotenuse of 20 units. What is the exact length of each leg?
An isosceles right triangle has one leg of 13 m. What are the three side lengths?
questions.explanation: An isosceles right triangle is a 45-45-90 triangle. The legs are both 13, and the hypotenuse is 13sqrt(2).

questions.question: A 45-45-90 triangle has a hypotenuse of 7sqrt(2) inches. What is its perimeter?
questions.explanation: Each leg is 7 because 7sqrt(2)/sqrt(2) = 7. The perimeter is 7 + 7 + 7sqrt(2) = 14 + 7sqrt(2).

questions.question: A right triangle with one acute angle of 45 degrees must be a 45-45-90 triangle.
questions.explanation: The angles in a triangle sum to 180 degrees. After 90 degrees and 45 degrees, the remaining angle is 45 degrees.

questions.question: If a leg of a 45-45-90 triangle is 5sqrt(2), then the hypotenuse is 10.
questions.explanation: Multiply the leg by sqrt(2): 5sqrt(2) x sqrt(2) = 5 x 2 = 10.

questions.question: A 45-45-90 triangle has a leg of 12. Its hypotenuse is ___.
questions.explanation: Multiply the leg by sqrt(2). The hypotenuse is 12sqrt(2).

questions.question: A 45-45-90 triangle has a hypotenuse of 16sqrt(2). Each leg is ___.
A classmate says a 45-45-90 triangle with hypotenuse 18 has legs of 18sqrt(2). Explain the mistake and give the correct leg length.
questions.correctAnswer: The classmate multiplied when they should have divided. Since 18 is the hypotenuse, each leg is 18/sqrt(2) = 9sqrt(2).
questions.explanation: The hypotenuse is already the longest side. Multiplying by sqrt(2) would make the leg longer than the hypotenuse, so the correct operation is division.

questions.question: Derive the 45-45-90 side relationship using a square with side length x.
questions.correctAnswer: A diagonal of the square makes a right triangle with equal legs x and x. By the Pythagorean Theorem, x^2 + x^2 = c^2, so 2x^2 = c^2 and c = xsqrt(2). The ratio is x:x:xsqrt(2).
questions.explanation: The derivation comes from the square diagonal: equal square sides become the equal legs, and the diagonal becomes the hypotenuse.
